releaseNotes:
PRVN Music v0.16.1 (Build 21):
- Repaired Listen Together real-time playback synchronization when host changes songs.
- Fixed listener auto-pause issue on track transitions.
- Fixed song resume starting from 0:00 instead of syncing to host's current position.
- Enhanced buffer barrier with adaptive polling for smooth group listening.
- Refreshed About Us -> Version screen with official PRVN Music Minimal Neon logo and PRVN attribution.
- Updated legal disclaimer and terms of use in-app and in repository documentation.
